title: Meet Middle C
description: Start on the toy piano's first C anchor and play Middle C a few times.
hint: Look for the highlighted C4 key near the left side of the toy piano.

title: Five-Finger Walk
description: Walk up and back down using five notes. Finger guides can be added in Phase 2B.
hint: Move step by step from C4 up to G4, then return to C4.

title: A Little Melody
description: Can you make a tiny song? Listen, then play each note in order.
hint: Take your time. There is no timer or penalty for trying a different note.

title: High and Low
description: Hear the difference between the toy piano's low C, middle C, and high C.
hint: C4 is low on this piano, C5 is higher, and C6 is highest.
